# Conformance evidence pack (Touchstone / Inferno / equivalent)

**Purpose:** Satisfy **Phase VII** exit criterion — objective artifacts for **RFPs** and **sales** without implying certification unless achieved.

**Not legal/certification advice.** Vendor programs (ONC, HL7) have their own rules.

## 4. Sales usage

- **Safe claims:** Reference **passing** rows only; attach PDF/HTML exports stored in your **internal** drive (not this repo with customer data).  
- **Unsafe:** “Certified” without official designation from the program.
